chunks: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Khalid from Muhammad b. Ali al-Kufi from Muhammad b. Sinan from Isa al-Nahryari from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:

Whoever recognizes Allah and glorifies Him will prevent his lips from speech and his stomach from food, and will occupy himself with fasting and standing in prayer. They said: May our fathers and our mothers be your sacrifice, O Messenger of Allah! Are these the friends of Allah? He said: Surely, the friends of Allah are silent and their silence becomes reflection; they talk and their talk becomes remembrance; they observe and their observation becomes a lesson; they speak and their speech becomes wisdom; they walk and their walking among the people becomes a blessing. Were it not for the terms that have been written upon them, their spirits would not have settled in their bodies out of fear of the punishment and out of desire for the reward.
ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of the friends of Allah according to the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (S) describes the characteristics of those who truly know God: they restrain their speech and appetite, devoting themselves to worship. When the companions ask if such people are the awliya' (friends) of Allah, the Prophet responds that the friends of Allah transform every action into spiritual significance -- their silence is contemplation, their speech is remembrance, their gaze yields lessons, their words are wisdom, and their presence among people is a blessing. Their souls would leave their bodies from fear and yearning were it not for their appointed terms.
